requirement: When a query requires information newer than the frozen knowledge snapshot, Mango deterministically routes to the current-information/web-research path and never presents stale frozen-snapshot content as current fact.
rule: Every temporal routing decision derives only from the permitted candidate-visible signal carriers registered here. No hidden gold metadata participates in any routing decision. The classification is deterministic: the same candidate-visible inputs always produce the same temporal intent and route.

forbidden_signals.enforcement: negative controls prove that removing every forbidden field from candidate-visible material leaves the runtime classification mechanism unchanged (protocol section 19)

A_query_semantics.routing_semantics: deterministic semantic classification: explicit-current cue families, superlative + time-scoped-noun scope rule, present-state role/value lexicon with present copula, past-tense frame, record-pinning frame, physics-sense suppression, self-contained referent rule

B_source_freshness_metadata.producer: runtime-native materializer over the frozen schema (sealed corpus)

C_source_as_of_observation_timestamps.producer: runtime-native materializer over the frozen schema (sealed at corpus build)
C_source_as_of_observation_timestamps.routing_semantics: per-source valid-through date; parsed ISO date; a source is current for a request when its date >= the request date or the corpus snapshot covers the request

D_snapshot_timestamp.routing_semantics: corpus-level valid-through: local snapshot evidence is current for a request only when request_date <= snapshot_date

E_runtime_request_timestamp.field: request.request_date (candidate-visible request field, threaded as answer_knowledge(now=...))
E_runtime_request_timestamp.producer: evaluation harness request record (frozen in the runtime data contract; one date per holdout row)
E_runtime_request_timestamp.routing_semantics: the 'current date' of the router; when absent, the runtime cannot establish that local evidence is current and applies the preregistered fail-safe mapping

F_explicit_user_supplied_as_of_date.routing_semantics: historical-as-of intent: the frozen snapshot answers the anchored frame; never routes to current research

STATIC.meaning: the query asks a timeless, record-pinned, or self-contained fact; snapshot evidence satisfies it at any request date
STATIC.action: ANSWER locally (web only when the boundary classifier independently requires it)

HISTORICAL_AS_OF.meaning: the query anchors its frame to a past date or past-tense state
HISTORICAL_AS_OF.action: ANSWER from the frozen snapshot (snapshot-compatible); never routed to current research

CURRENT_REQUIRED.meaning: the query explicitly requires present/current state (explicit cue family or superlative over a time-scoped referent)
CURRENT_REQUIRED.action: ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH when the snapshot is not current for the request date (mandatory); ANSWER locally only when the snapshot validly covers the request date

RECENCY_SENSITIVE.meaning: the fact class is present-state (role/value lexicon) in a present-tense frame without an explicit cue
RECENCY_SENSITIVE.action: route per evidence freshness: ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH when request_date > snapshot_date; ANSWER from the frozen frame when request_date <= snapshot_date; when request_date is unknown, ANSWER from the frozen frame (the answer can never claim currency)

AMBIGUOUS_FRESHNESS.meaning: a temporal word matched whose deterministic scope rule did not resolve (superlative over a non-time-scoped noun, non-self-contained)
AMBIGUOUS_FRESHNESS.action: deterministic ambiguity policy: answer locally unless runtime-visible source metadata establishes the fact class is present-state (a TIME_SENSITIVE source retrieved with request_date > snapshot_date routes)

router_precedence: 1. boundary routing (document / memory / compute / web-cue / science) — unchanged from the frozen runtime
2. explicit current-information requirement (cue or superlative+time-scoped noun or inherent-recency phrase) -> CURRENT_REQUIRED
3. record-pinning / snapshot-internal framing -> STATIC (the record is the evidence universe)
4. explicit historical/as-of anchor or past-tense frame -> HISTORICAL_AS_OF
5. present-state fact class (role/value lexicon) with present copula -> RECENCY_SENSITIVE
6. unresolved temporal word -> AMBIGUOUS_FRESHNESS (deterministic ambiguity policy)
No evaluator-dependent branch exists anywhere in this precedence.

snapshot_staleness_rule.rule: CURRENT_REQUIRED or RECENCY_SENSITIVE intent + request_date present + request_date > corpus snapshot_date => the local snapshot is stale for this request and ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH is mandatory; request_date <= snapshot_date => the snapshot validly covers the request and the local path is the preregistered allowed current path
snapshot_staleness_rule.invariant: CURRENT_REQUIRED + snapshot not current => never ANSWER (protocol section 13, mechanically tested)

no_stale_fallback.rule: For CURRENT_REQUIRED: when the current route is unavailable the runtime must NOT silently answer from the frozen snapshot. Preregistered fail-safe behavior: ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH (the runtime's web-research route always exists in evaluation); when an explicit request_date is absent the runtime cannot establish that the snapshot is current, so CURRENT_REQUIRED routes to web research. The runtime never asserts stale snapshot content as current truth (the snapshot-current claim guard remains active on every composed answer).
allowed_actions: ANSWER when request_date <= snapshot_date (the snapshot is the allowed current path)
forbidden_actions: ANSWER presenting snapshot state as current when request_date > snapshot_date or request_date unknown

static_query_invariant.rule: STATIC intent answers locally; the web route fires only when the boundary classifier independently requires live evidence (boundary web cues) or runtime-visible source metadata establishes a present-state requirement (protocol section 14)
static_query_invariant.counter_pressure: static_query_unnecessary_web_routing <= 0.03 (frozen floor, 180-row design-mandated population); the repair must not become 'when uncertain, always web'

runtime_date_source.rule: The 'current date' used by the router comes only from the explicit runtime request field request_date threaded through answer_knowledge(now=...). The pipeline never reads the wall clock. No hardcoded current year, no model-memory date guess, no training-cutoff inference.
runtime_date_source.producer: evaluation harness request record (frozen in candidate_runtime_data_contract)
runtime_date_source.absence_policy: request_date absent => CURRENT_REQUIRED routes to web research (cannot establish snapshot currency); RECENCY_SENSITIVE/AMBIGUOUS answer from the frozen frame without asserting currency

source_freshness_semantics.STATIC: never changes (historical events, authored works, registered record contents); satisfies any non-current-required query at any request date
source_freshness_semantics.SLOW_CHANGING: stable over the snapshot horizon (capitals, seats of government); satisfies present-state frames and is exempt from the staleness routing rule; an explicit CURRENT_REQUIRED cue still overrides the snapshot when the request date exceeds it
source_freshness_semantics.TIME_SENSITIVE: can change faster than the snapshot (officeholders, prices, versions); retrieved TIME_SENSITIVE evidence plus request_date > snapshot_date establishes a present-state requirement through metadata alone
source_freshness_semantics.UNKNOWN: cannot establish currency; exempt from the metadata routing rule (conservative: local answer, never asserting currency)

frozen_vocabularies.explicit_current_cues: the frozen _EXPLICIT_CURRENT family of src/sciencemath/knowledge/freshness.py (current, currently, today, now, right now, this week/month/year/quarter, so far, at present, as we speak, live, present-day, modern-day, nowadays, these days, as of now, at the moment) — proper-noun compound suppression and physics-sense suppression apply

physics_sense_suppression.rule: the noun 'current' in a physics/electrical sense is not a currency cue: suppressed when preceded by a frozen physics modifier (ocean, air, tidal, water, electric, electrical, alternating, direct, eddy, convection) or followed by 'in <electrical|electric|physics|ocean|air|water|tidal|circuit|conductor>' context, or when the frame is a definition lookup ('define current', 'definition of current')

fields.producer: evaluation harness request record (one per holdout row)
fields.serialization: holdout row field; never serialized into gold-only metadata
